review.note: Reviewed all 15 Python and 3 Node direct requirement entries, including latest registry candidates beyond declared bounds. The only changed registry candidate since the previous reviewed receipt is h2hdb 0.37.3; the remaining external candidates and their release-note reviews are unchanged and all current candidates satisfy their declared bounds and support Python 3.14. Compared core 0.37.0 through 0.37.3: public domain values and catalog/queue facades are unchanged. The 0.38.0 candidate changes administration provisioning results and ingest internals, while the OPDS public read-only catalog contract and schema epoch 3/version 6 are unchanged. Verified local core 0.38.0 wheel SHA-256 5266df990ffbe753817c6f4a7ade0ab5aea31b186bd8fedda30f05cba969d232 in an independently rebuilt environment; consumer editable and core wheel origins were checked. Widened the core requirement to >=0.36.0,<0.39.0, retaining previously verified catalog-compatible lanes without a shim or data migration. Built-wheel metadata tests now accept 0.38 and exclude unreviewed 0.39. The full bounded check-full.sh gate passed Ruff, formatter, strict mypy, Markdown, OPDS schemas, all 836 non-deep tests in 54.33 seconds, sdist-to-wheel build and isolated wheel smoke; total gate duration was 64.91 seconds with owned process group empty. This includes the real 165-publication SQLite HTTP fixture, explicitly generated by the current core checkout using the tested core wheel, and exact fixture receipt validation. The fixture generator was updated by core to consume the new provisioning outcome instead of the removed audit-result field; no consumer fallback was added. All latest external dependencies were installed through the complete resolver. The final merge gate and complete deployment cohort evidence are reported separately; this bounded gate does not claim the deep 10k/100k or live service profiles.
